label: first copy-phase input (step after <DEL>) in long (L=9) sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely (88% of mass) at the step right after <DEL>, where the input is the first original token fed back and the model outputs original token 1 (recall_idx 1), with a smaller share at recall_idx 2 (11%). Strongly length-gated: L=9 holds 86% of mass, L=8 12%, L<=7 essentially none. Never fires in the original phase or at the <DEL> step. Within L=9 recall_idx-1 steps only about half fire; the input/first-token identity modulates this and magnitude (r, n, d, l, o, u, g, f, q, b, w favored, top activations are r/n/d; h, x, y, m, t, digits mostly silent), but a token whitelist trades too much recall for precision. The broader (recall_idx==1)&(L>=8) has 87% mass recall at 32% precision.
